_comment: Hand overrides for sfile's format table. These replace the generator's derived entry for the named task. Every layout here is a published, well-known file-format header (not a guess); each was verified against a real sample file in the test loop. Keys are task numbers as strings. Field kinds: u8/u16/u32/u64 (unsigned LE unless endian=be), i8/i16/i32/i64, f32/f64, ascii, bytes.
